turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's essay.
Before we continue what? I came about a zero on Owen's essay.
If I find out this meeting is being run by an AI, I'm reporting it to the school board and the law society.
Report whatever you like, in writing. Who decided on the zero?
So last chance. Person or program?
If you need to stop, stop. Otherwise, Owen.
